The archive prefix must be a multiple of 512 bytes.
    - a prefix of 1 byte
    - a prefix of 100 bytes
    - a prefix of 511 bytes
    - a prefix of 513 bytes
    - a prefix of 1000 bytes and other sectors
    - a prefix of 100 bytes before no files
    - a prefix of 100 bytes before a duplicate

Duplicate archive path 'a.TXT' (also 'A.txt').
    hint: Archive paths are case-insensitive; rename one of the files.
    - a name in both cases

Duplicate archive path 'A.TXT' (also 'a.txt').
    hint: Archive paths are case-insensitive; rename one of the files.
    - a name in both cases, the small letters first

Duplicate archive path 'a.txt' (also 'a.txt').
    hint: Archive paths are case-insensitive; rename one of the files.
    - one name twice

Duplicate archive path 'A.txt' (also 'a.txt').
    hint: Archive paths are case-insensitive; rename one of the files.
    - a name three times

Duplicate archive path 'WAR3MAPIMPORTED\icon.BLP' (also 'war3mapImported\Icon.blp').
    hint: Archive paths are case-insensitive; rename one of the files.
    - a folder in both cases

Duplicate archive path 'B' (also 'b').
    hint: Archive paths are case-insensitive; rename one of the files.
    - two pairs

Duplicate archive path 'UNITS\FILE017.TXT' (also 'Units\file017.txt').
    hint: Archive paths are case-insensitive; rename one of the files.
    - a pair among forty files

Duplicate archive path 'X.MDX' (also 'x.mdx').
    hint: Archive paths are case-insensitive; rename one of the files.
    - a pair after an HM3W header

Duplicate archive path '(LISTFILE)' (also '(listfile)').
    hint: Archive paths are case-insensitive; rename one of the files.
    - its own (listfile) twice

Duplicate archive path '(listfile)' (also '(listfile)').
    hint: Archive paths are case-insensitive; rename one of the files.
    - its own (listfile) twice, alike

Duplicate archive path '' (also '').
    hint: Archive paths are case-insensitive; rename one of the files.
    - the empty name twice

Duplicate archive path 'Ã©.TXT' (also 'Ã©.txt').
    hint: Archive paths are case-insensitive; rename one of the files.
    - a name that is not ASCII, its ASCII letters in both cases

Duplicate archive path 'ÿ.BIN' (also 'ÿ.bin').
    hint: Archive paths are case-insensitive; rename one of the files.
    - a name that is not UTF-8 twice
